Author: P Gopinath Bench: P Gopinath WP(C) No.35573/2022 1/1  IN THE HIGH COURT OF KERALA AT ERNAKULAM  PRESENT  THE HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE GOPINATH P.
 Thursday, the 23rd day of March 2023 / 2nd Chaithra, 1945  WP(C) NO. 35573 OF 2022 (V)
 PETITIONER:
 CICILY XAVIER, AGED 75 YEARS, W/O XAVIER, KOLAPARAMBIL,
 PALARIVATTOM, KOCHI - 682 025.
 RESPONDENTS:
 1. THE SPECIAL TAHSILDAR (LA), CORPORATION OF KOCHI, VYTILLA ZONAL  OFFICE, KOCHI - 682 019.
 2. TAHSILDAR (LR), KANAYANOOR TALUK OFFICE, ERNAKULAM DISTRICT - 682  011.
 3. CORPORATION OF COCHIN, REPRESENTED BY ITS SECRETARY, MARINE DRIVE,
 ERNAKULAM - 682011 [ADDL. R3 IMPLEADED AS PER ORDER DATED 30-11-2022  IN IA 1/22 IN WP(C) 35573/2022]
 Writ petition (civil) praying inter alia that in the circumstances  stated in the affidavit filed along with the WP(C) the High Court be  pleased to direct the 1st respondent to pass an award in respect of 1 cent  of land which is the 3rd Schedule in Ext P1 sale deed, fixing compensation  at the same rate as has been fixed in respect of the adjoining lands  acquired invoking the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act.
 This petition again coming on for admission upon perusing the  petition and the affidavit filed in support of WP(C) and this court's  order dated 19/01/2023 and upon hearing the arguments of M/S.MATHEW JOHN  (K) & ABY J AUGUSTINE Advocates for the petitioner and SRI. JANARDHANA  SHENOY Advocate for R3 and of the GOVERNMENT PLEADER, the court passed the

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF KERALA AT ERNAKULAM
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: ORDER The 1st respondent [The Special Tahsildar (LA) Corporation of Kochi] shall remain present before this court at 11.00 A.M on 31.03.2023.
Post on 31.03.2023 Sd/- GOPINATH P., JUDGE 23-03-2023 /True Copy/
